## Outreach - Setup
Run manually once. Safe to re-run.

- Creates Contacts, Outreach, Mail Log, Outreach Templates, Outreach Config, Outreach Plan tabs in **Switch Contacts**
- Adds companyId / isPriority / outreachStatus / outreachAt / applied to **Result**, companyId to **Low Match**, Aliases to **Companies**
- Seeds config (mode = DRY_RUN) and 6 templates
- First run only: marks every existing job LEGACY and imports the Cold Mailing tab (reads each Gmail thread for the real mail count and replies)
